title: Deep Learning for Computer Vision
standfirst: CNNs, detection, segmentation and the modern architectures that read images and video.

resources.label: Topic-wise notes
resources.desc: Topic-wise notes on ML Study Hub.

resources_note: An IITM email may be required for some of the resources above; any other access request will be strictly rejected.

description_paragraphs: This course covers the fundamentals of image processing and computer vision, along with core deep learning models such as feedforward networks, CNNs, RNNs, and transformers. It also introduces generative AI and recent trends, including explainability, zero-shot, few-shot, and self-supervised learning, while providing hands-on experience in implementing basic, deep learning-based, and advanced computer vision tasks. This course is also offered as an elective for PG-diploma students.
faculty: Prof. Vineeth N B, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, IIT Hyderabad

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Image representation; Filtering; Frequency domain; Sampling.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Edge detection; Feature extraction; Scale-space; SIFT; Segmentation; Visual perception.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Neural networks; Backpropagation; Optimization; Regularization; Training improvements.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Introduction to convolutional neural networks (CNNs); Backpropagation in CNNs; CNN architectures for image classification (AlexNet, VGG).

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: CNN evolution; Modern architectures; Fine-tuning; Visualization.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Object detection; Two-stage and single-stage models; Image segmentation.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Introduction to recurrent neural networks (RNNs); Backpropagation through time; LSTM and GRU architectures; Video understanding using CNNs and RNNs.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Attention in vision; Image captioning; VQA and dialog; Transformers.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Vision transformers; Transformer-based object detection; Transformer-based image segmentation.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Deep Generative Models: Review of (Popular) Deep Generative Models: GANs, VAEs; Other Generative Models: PixelRNNs, NADE, Normalizing Flows, etc

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Diffusion models and DDPMs; Denoising diffusion processes; Classifier-based and classifier-free guidance techniques.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Contrastive and self-supervised learning; Vision-language models; Multimodal LLMs; Conclusion.
